name: MATRIX
recent: Matrix Concepts 近期在柔佛古来推进扩张，以 RM169.3 million 收购约 174.77 公顷农业地，并公布当地工业项目 GDV 约 RM1.07 billion。同时，公司在 Sendayan 启动护理设施建设，董事在闭门期内外有股份交易。
notable: 全资子公司 Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd 以 RM169,313,523 收购古来 57 幅农业地，总面积约 174.7749 公顷。
公司公布古来工业项目 GDV 约 RM1.07 billion，并预计从 FY29 起每年贡献 RM47.3 million 利润。
公司在 Sendayan 的 Avida Mercy Care Centre 护理设施举行动土仪式。
risks: 执行副主席 Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock 在闭门期内及闭门期外多次进行股份交易。
独立非执行董事 Encik Mazhairul bin Jamaludin 在公开市场购入股份。
earnings: 截至 2026-06-30 季度，营收为 RM315.578 million，环比增长 2.2%，同比增长 11.0%；净利为 RM60.189 million，环比增长 55.5%，同比下降 4.4%；净利率为 19.1%，高于上一季度的 12.5%。

recent_en: Matrix Concepts is expanding in Kulai, Johor, with the acquisition of about 174.77 hectares of agricultural land for RM169.3 million and an industrial project with estimated GDV of RM1.07 billion. It also broke ground on a nursing care facility in Sendayan, while directors traded shares both within and outside the closed period.
notable_en: Wholly-owned Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd is acquiring 57 agricultural land parcels in Kulai, totaling about 174.7749 hectares, for RM169,313,523.
The company announced an industrial project in Kulai with estimated GDV of RM1.07 billion and projected annual profit contribution of RM47.3 million from FY29.
The company held a groundbreaking ceremony for the Avida Mercy Care Centre nursing facility in Sendayan.
risks_en: Group Executive Deputy Chairman Dato' Seri Lee Tian Hock conducted multiple share trades during and outside the closed period.
Senior Independent Non-Executive Director Encik Mazhairul bin Jamaludin acquired shares in the open market.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was RM315.578 million, up 2.2% QoQ and 11.0% YoY; net income was RM60.189 million, up 55.5% QoQ but down 4.4% YoY; net margin was 19.1%, up from 12.5% in the previous quarter.
